name: Miracles Through Evil Agents
overview: Scripture warns that false prophets and dreamers may perform signs and wonders to lead people astray, encouraging the worship of other gods, as seen in Deuteronomy 13:1-3. The magicians of Egypt, empowered by enchantments, mimicked God's miracles during the Exodus, demonstrating that such wonders can be wrought through evil agents (Exodus 7:11, 7:22, 8:7). These miracles serve as a mark of apostasy and deception, designed to support false religions and deceive the ungodly, and must not be regarded as genuine works of God.
